Q: How can I retrieve the fraction of functions with examples purely from an R Package source archive without installing that package? A:

This might be straigtforward, untar and search man/*.Rd files for @examples. tools::parse_Rd() might be helpful.

Q: Applying relief (emboss) effect to bitmap using GetPixel/SetPixel in C# WinForms A:

Get/SetPixel has a bunch of extra work that is repeated each time it is called. This includes checking that the x/y coordinates are valid and P/Invoke call to gdiplus.dll. All of this require a bunch of extra instructions. You can read the source for GetPixel yourself here. When I measure, a single GetPixel takes about 80ns.

If you are using LockBits you get a pointer, and reading a value from a pointer is just a single instruction. This take about 0.2ns when I measure it. But it do require that you use unsafe code, and that you are comfortable with using pointers.

Of course, if you do not care about performance it is perfectly fine to continue using Get/SetPixel.
